# opnsense_kea_ctrl_agent_settings (Resource)

Kea control agent settings (**Services ▸ Kea DHCP ▸ Control Agent**). The control agent is the REST API Kea HA peers use to talk to each other. This is a singleton: import it with the ID `kea_ctrl_agent_settings` before managing it. Attributes left unset keep their current value.

## Example Usage

```terraform
import {
  to = opnsense_kea_ctrl_agent_settings.this
  id = "kea_ctrl_agent_settings"
}

resource "opnsense_kea_ctrl_agent_settings" "this" {
  enabled   = true
  http_host = "127.0.0.1"
  http_port = 8000
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable the Kea control agent (REST API used by HA peers).
- `http_host` (String) IPv4 address the control agent listens on.
- `http_port` (Number) Port the control agent listens on. `-1` when unset; set `-1` to clear it.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `kea_ctrl_agent_settings`.
